title: The Holy League defeats the Ottoman fleet at Lepanto
summary: A fleet of Spain, Venice, the Papal States and their allies under Don John of Austria destroyed most of the Ottoman navy at the mouth of the Gulf of Patras.
reason: The Ottomans had invaded Venetian Cyprus, and Pope Pius V formed a league to stop their naval expansion.
significance: It ended the image of Ottoman invincibility at sea and was the last great battle of oared galleys.
place: Gulf of Patras, off Lepanto (Nafpaktos), Greece
